scripts.build: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/shared build && pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/db build && pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api build && pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/web build
scripts.db:migrate:local: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply anuvarnika-db --local
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 execute anuvarnika-db --local --file=../../packages/db/seeds/seed-uat.sql
scripts.db:seed:local:clean: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 execute anuvarnika-db --local --file=../../packages/db/seeds/seed-prod.sql
scripts.db:migrate:uat: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply anuvarnika-db-uat --env uat --remote
scripts.db:seed:uat: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 execute anuvarnika-db-uat --env uat --remote --file=../../packages/db/seeds/seed-uat.sql
scripts.db:migrate:prod: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 migrations apply anuvarnika-db-prod --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:prod: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/api exec wrangler d1 execute anuvarnika-db-prod --env production --remote --file=../../packages/db/seeds/seed-prod.sql
scripts.deploy:web:uat: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/web exec vite build --mode uat && pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/web exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name anuvarnika-web-uat
scripts.deploy:web:prod: pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/web exec vite build --mode production && pnpm --filter @anuvarnika/web exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name anuvarnika-web-prod
